name: code-graph-rag
description: Query a multi-language codebase as a knowledge graph — parse repositories into function, class, and dependency relationships, then answer structural questions over that graph.

skills.name: Repository Parsing
skills.description: Parses source across many languages with tree-sitter and stores functions, classes, and imports as graph nodes.

skills.name: Graph Querying
skills.description: Answers natural-language questions by translating them into graph queries over code structure and call relationships.

skills.name: Dependency Tracing
skills.description: Traces callers, callees, and cross-module dependencies to show blast radius before a change is made.
